title: The Elamites raid Babylon (Shutruk-Nakhunte)
description: Added from the Generations curriculum import (Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020)). Dated only by the Generations books cited below; no tier 1–4 chronology covers this event.

sorting_basis.note: PROVISIONAL: no CFAH, Ussher–Jones or Ussher date exists, so the sort uses Generations (Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024), PDF p. 271): the death of Sargon II in 705 BC. Pending owner decision (open question A8).

chronologies.note: pending CFAH reference (the CFAH series does not cover this period; no tier 1–4 date exists)

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020), ch. 4 "First Empires in Mesopotamia (2360–1750 BC)", PDF p. 106 (printed p. 105)
chronologies.note: The Elamites invade Babylon "around 1150 BC" and carry off the Hammurabi stele. The Timeline Review (p. 388) prints 1160 BC.
chronologies.edition_note: 1st ed. (2020); superseded by the 2nd ed. (2024), which prints "the death of Sargon II in 705 BC" (PDF p. 271): 445 years later.

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020), ch. 12 "The Kingdom of the Medes and Persians (725–330 BC)", PDF p. 388 (printed p. 387)
chronologies.edition_note: 1st ed. (2020); superseded by the 2nd ed. (2024), which prints "the death of Sargon II in 705 BC" (PDF p. 271): 455 years later.

chronologies.date: the death of Sargon II in 705 BC
chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024), ch. 11 "God Reveals His Law to Man–From Creation to Solomon", PDF p. 271 (printed p. 257)
chronologies.note: The Elamites carried the Hammurabi stele off to Susa "a few years before" Sargon II died in 705 BC (pp. 270–271); no year is printed for the raid, and Shutruk-Nakhunte is not named.
